description: This file defines an enumeration `JsonSchemaVersion` representing different versions of JSON schemas within the project, including methods for version management, type checks, and related utility functions.

classes.name: JsonSchemaVersion
classes.description: An enumeration of JSON schema versions that implements JsonFieldMarker and Predicate<JsonField>. It provides utilities to handle schema versioning including deprecated versions.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JsonKey associated with schema versioning, used as a field marker in JSON objects.

methods.name: forInt
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the JsonSchemaVersion that matches the provided integer, if any.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Returns the schema version as an integer.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Evaluates whether a given JsonField is marked with this schema version.
